products.product_description: Blue Tape Sriracha sauce is refrigerated condiment, packaged in a 10.5oz clear squeeze bottle, sold individually. Ingredients: Chilies, Garlic, Capsicum, Sugar, Salt, White Wine Vinegar. There is no company address on the label and no UPC code.
products.code_info: Best by date was marked on each bottle for 6 months from the date it was produced. No lot codes.
products.reason_for_recall: Acidified product was manufactured by firm without ODA license.
